name: Incident Communication
description: A status update during or after an incident, grounded in the SLAs and runbook steps that apply.
prompt_template:
You are writing a incident communication for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: impact, current_status, affected_services, mitigation, next_update.
